_doc: Swiss decision sources entscheidsuche MISSES — web-verified, from the 2026-06-21 beyond-es research (26 cantons + federal + cross-cutting). es is a federal+supreme-court backbone, not a complete index. These publish online but are NOT aggregated by es. Ingestion = gated /feature backlog, ranked by priority (1=high). Companion to the es-universe catalogue data/swiss_court_sources.json.
summary: entscheidsuche (es) is a federal-court + cantonal-supreme-court BACKBONE, not a complete index of published Swiss decisions. Across 26 cantons + federal + cross-cutting review, es is essentially complete for the appellate/supreme tier in most small cantons (NW, GL, AI, SH, OW, UR, LU, GR appellate, VS courts, AR courts) because those cantons consolidate admin/tax/social-insurance jurisdiction inside one Obergericht/Kantonsgericht that es already mirrors. The beyond-es frontier is real but concentrated in three places: (a) DIRECTORATE / EXECUTIVE administrative-appeal jurisprudence that never reaches the courts (Bern's Direktionen, ZH Rekursentscheide+RRB, SO/BS Regierungsrat databases, NE jurisprudenceadm.ne.ch, the GVP/EGV-SZ yearbooks for SG/SZ/ZG); (b) SPECIALIZED COMMISSIONS with their own portals (BS Steuerrekurskommission + BStP tax portal + Personalrekurskommission + Anwaltsaufsichtskommission, GE Commission du barreau 'dcba', FR Commission du barreau + ASRF/CRRF, several cantonal data-protection/transparency authorities, and a cluster of federal regulators — ESBK, RAB/ASR, ESchK-Schiedskommission, Preisüberwacher); (c) FEDERAL post-2016 authority output (CH_VB only covers the static VPB archive 1982-2016, so any admin.ch portal after 2016 is a gap). Quantitatively the depth problem is large where es is shallow (repo direct vs es: GE 166,845 vs 88,603; VD 155,349 vs 81,689; BS ~10,100 vs 128; BL 16,947 vs 772), but most of that depth is recovered by ingesting each cantonal judiciary's OWN portal directly rather than by adding new bodies. After dropping every source not verified to publish online (all Schlichtungsbehörden, ZH/UR/OW/NW/VS/SH/GR non-publishing commissions, VS Conseil d'État, ZH Anwaltsaufsicht), the de-duplicated ingestion catalogue is ~28 discrete sources. The biggest single high-feasibility wins are: the federal regulators (ESBK, RAB/ASR, ESchK-Schiedskommission, Preisüberwacher — clean PDF archives), Bern's directorate decision archives (GSI, KAIO-procurement, BKD), the BS commission cluster (Steuerrekurskommission, BStP, Personalrekurs, Anwaltsaufsicht, Regierungsratsbeschlüsse app), the SO and ZH Regierungsrat/Rekurs databases, NE's jurisprudenceadm.ne.ch, and the GE Commission du barreau 'dcba' collection. The genuinely un-recoverable layer is first-instance conciliation output (Schlichtungsbehörden), which essentially no body publishes online anywhere.
systemic_gaps: DEPTH within courts es already lists: es aggregates one shallow spider per canton and captures only what each court's portal exposes through it. Cantonal judiciaries' OWN portals are materially deeper for the SAME courts — repo direct-scrape vs es proves it: GE 166,845 vs 88,603 (~53% coverage), VD 155,349 vs 81,689, BS ~10,106 vs 128, BL 16,947 vs 772. Recovering this needs direct ingestion of each cantonal judiciary portal, not new bodies.

WHOLE CHAMBERS / SUB-COURTS folded into one coarse spider: ZH (Handelsgericht, Bezirksgerichte, Arbeitsgericht, Mietgericht, ZMG all behind the single ZH_Obergericht spider), plus district/commercial/social-insurance/tax sub-courts in ZH/BS/SG/AG that es treats as one-or-zero spiders.

EXECUTIVE / DIRECTORATE administrative-appeal jurisprudence that never reaches the courts: Regierungsrat + Direktionen/départements recourse decisions are a whole track es ignores. Confirmed online for ZH (Rekursentscheide), BE (GSI/KAIO/BKD/DIJ directorates), SO (rrb.so.ch), BS (Regierungsratsbeschlüsse app), NE (jurisprudenceadm.ne.ch), and via yearbook digests for SG (GVP), SZ (EGV-SZ), ZG (GVP/LexWork).

SPECIALIZED COMMISSIONS with independent portals that es does not aggregate: lawyer-supervision (GE 'dcba', FR/BS Anwaltsaufsicht), tax commissions (BS Steuerrekurskommission + BStP), personnel-appeals (BS Personalrekurskommission), land-registry (FR ASRF/CRRF, BE Grundbuch/Notariat), and cantonal/inter-cantonal data-protection & transparency authorities (TI CCPDT, GE PPDT, FR ATPrDM, JU/NE CPDT-JUNE).

FEDERAL post-2016 authority output: CH_VB only crawls the static VPB archive (1982-2016), so any federal authority publishing on its own admin.ch portal after 2016 is a gap — ESBK, RAB/ASR, ESchK-Schiedskommission (copyright tariffs), Preisüberwacher all confirmed online and absent.

DECISION TYPES es never reaches: (a) first-instance conciliation output (Schlichtungsbehörden — rent/labour/equality) is the genuinely un-recoverable layer, essentially never published by any body online; the only partial surfacing is the topical BWO Mietrecht-DB and the national equality-law.ch aggregator. (b) Curated/paywalled collections that are the ONLY online channel for some courts — most acutely the Basel-Stadt Appellationsgericht, which does not self-publish and sends only a selection to Swisslex/BJM; plus ZBl and Der Steuerentscheid for cantonal admin/tax jurisprudence. These require a licensing path, not scraping.

es is best treated as a federal-court + cantonal-supreme-court BACKBONE, not a complete index. Several small cantons (NW, GL, AI, SH, OW, UR, LU, GR appellate) ARE essentially complete in es because they consolidate admin/tax/social-insurance jurisdiction into one Obergericht/Kantonsgericht — adding bodies there is wasted effort; the frontier is concentrated in the larger/multi-body cantons and at the federal regulator + executive-recourse layers.
top_recommendations: Federal regulators (clean, high-feasibility PDF archives, all post-2016 gaps CH_VB misses): ESBK (esbk.admin.ch/de/rechtsprechung), RAB/ASR (rab-asr.ch/de/verfuegungen-der-rab), ESchK-Schiedskommission copyright tariffs (eschk.admin.ch/de/beschluesse), Preisüberwacher (preisueberwacher.admin.ch). One-index-page-plus-PDF-links scrapes each; do these first.

Executive / administrative-recourse databases — the single largest net-new content type: NE jurisprudenceadm.ne.ch (several thousand decisions, FindinfoWeb full-text), ZH Rekursentscheide (whole admin-recourse track, structured DB), SO rrb.so.ch (53k+ docs Solr-backed, filter substantive Rekurs). Each unlocks an entire jurisdiction es ignores.

Bern directorate decision archives (easy per-year PDF tables, GSI ~35-40/yr): GSI, then KAIO public-procurement, then BKD. Confirmed live, trivially scrapeable; BE_BVD is the only directorate currently in es, so these are clean additions (dedupe KAIO vs BE_BVD for BVD-issued procurement).

ZH gerichte-zh.ch non-Obergericht spruchkörper (Handelsgericht, Bezirksgerichte, Arbeitsgericht, Mietgericht, ZMG): ONE crawl target already hosting Obergericht unlocks 5+ court types es omits, with Bezirksgerichte volume growing from 2025. Highest court-layer depth win per unit of effort (repo already proves ~34k ZH sub-court decisions recoverable).

Basel-Stadt commission cluster (own portals, all free): Steuerrekurskommission (hundreds of STRK PDFs), BStP tax portal (~509 since 1996), Personalrekurskommission, Anwaltsaufsichtskommission, and the Regierungsratsbeschlüsse app (~15k). BS is a known es desert (~128 vs ~10,100 direct), so these materially extend coverage.

TI CCPDT (data-protection/transparency, 100+ decisions, predictable PDF URLs) and GE Commission du barreau 'dcba' (structured-DB, distinct collection on the same apps/decis engine es only partially crawls) — two clean, high-confidence, easy commission gaps.

BWO Mietrecht-Datenbank (federal topical rental-law DB) + a single national ingest of equality-law.ch with per-canton dedupe — these two together capture the conciliation-adjacent decision types es structurally never reaches, far more efficiently than chasing per-canton Schlichtungsbehörden (which publish nothing).

Defer (and treat as licensing, not scraping): ZBl-online, Der Steuerentscheid/legalis, and Swisslex/Weblaw — including the Basel-Stadt Appellationsgericht selection that exists ONLY on Swisslex/BJM. Pursue via acquisition once the free, scrapeable frontier above is ingested.
